description: Get the latest intraday reading for active U.S. listings (consolidated SIP: last trade, UTC time, freshness, bid/ask, session, the regular close once settled, change from the previous close, day volume) and for MIC:TICKER listings on a Canadian exchange (XTSE, XTSX, XCNQ, NEOE; e.g. XTSE:RY), Euronext (XPAR, XAMS, XBRU, XMSM, XOSL, MTAA, XLIS; e.g. XPAR:AIR), NSE (e.g. XNSE:RELIANCE) or BSE (XBOM, BSE-only companies), in the listing's currency. Paid plans only: U.S. is real time on Pro, 15 minutes delayed on Plus; Canadian is real time on XTSE and XTSX, 15 minutes behind on XCNQ and NEOE; Euronext trails 15 minutes (Delayed=true); Indian readings are fetched on request (Delayed=true when trailing). A reading older than the settled daily close answers with that close, timed at the session's end. Free gets an upgrade note. Stale=true: the reading predates the session expected now. Missing readings are listed. Settled daily bars: GetLatestClosingPrices or GetStockPrices.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols (max 25): a bare ticker for a U.S. listing, MIC:TICKER for a Canadian, Euronext, NSE or BSE one.
